_description: Per-finding allowlist for scripts/audit/run_all_audits.py HIGH findings. Each entry is a known, human-reviewed item -- either a scanner false positive or accepted/tracked technical debt -- NOT a blanket count baseline. Any finding whose fingerprint is not in this list fails the audit-baseline CI job (fix the code, or add a new reviewed entry here).
_how_to_add_entries: python3 scripts/audit/check_baseline.py extended_audit_report.json ci/baselines/extended_audit_baseline.json --severities HIGH --dump-new -- review the output, then merge the printed entries into this file. Never edit scripts/audit/performance_audit.py or security_audit.py to special-case a finding.
_root_cause: 2026-11-05: the 48 bulk-accepted N_PLUS_ONE_QUERY rows of 2026-10-10 were triaged one by one. 47 were repaired: code-uniqueness preflights are one search per create/write batch (facility_profile, material_profile, claims); image/intake/profile/transaction counts are grouped reads (offer, crm_bridge, material_profile, intake); cron and action loops collect their rows and create once, and dedupe with one query (automation, claims, enrichment, transaction, logistics, facility_profile); the offer price autofill is one match-line lookup per create batch; the documents_native keyset pagination was a scanner false positive and performance_audit.py now recognises that shape. The one entry left carries its review reason. Every entry must carry one; a fixed line changes its fingerprint, so a repaired row is pruned in the same change.

entries.review: REAL_ACCEPT (2026-11-05). action_inject creates one plasticos.material.profile per extracted raw material that has no existing (partner, polymer, form) identity. The record it creates must be visible to the next raw material in the same run so a repeated identity merges into it (merge-not-overwrite, with its own 'merged fields' chatter post and provenance rows) instead of duplicating it. A deferred create(list) would change that observable order and the merge path for same-run repeats, so the per-identity create stays. The profile lookup that fed it (the former per-material search, line 600) is now one query per run.
